name: doctor-auditor
description: Local-first encounter review system for clinician-patient conversations

scripts.check:desktop: npm run typecheck:desktop && npm run test:desktop
scripts.check:dashboard: npm run typecheck:dashboard && npm run test:dashboard
scripts.check:server: cd server && python -m compileall app && pytest -q
scripts.check:contracts: npm run check:shared && npm run check:server
scripts.check:ui: npm run check:desktop && npm run check:dashboard
scripts.check:all: npm run check:shared && npm run check:desktop && npm run check:dashboard && npm run check:server
scripts.test: npm run test:desktop && npm run test:dashboard
